text:
Olivia Chen: Hi team — just unboxed my company MBP and went through the initial setup. At the Remote Management screen it threw an error: "Device enrollment failed: device not assigned". I used my home Wi-Fi and my serial is C02Z7Y8X9. What am I missing? macOS Sonoma on M2.

rachel-it: Welcome Olivia! That message usually means the device hasn't been assigned to our Apple Business Manager (ABM) account or the assignment hasn't synced to Kandji. Can you confirm the serial and the asset tag on the packing slip? Also did you use a company-sent enrollment link or the out-of-box setup?

Olivia Chen: Serial above, asset tag on box 1147-OLV. I followed the out-of-box setup, didn't use any special link.

julia-it-ops: Thanks — looks like this was shipped from partner stock but wasn't claimed in ABM. I'll escalate to procurement to assign the serial to Redwood's ABM. In the meantime, two options: (A) we can generate a temporary local admin account so you can finish setup and we'll re-enroll the device later, or (B) wait for ABM assignment and then re-run setup from Recovery to trigger automated DEP/MDM enrollment. Which do you prefer?

Olivia Chen: I have a client call in 90m, so option A would be best. Is temporary admin safe?

rachel-it: We do temp admins for onboarding. People-ops approval required for audit. The account will be time-limited and we'll remove admin rights and enroll the device into Kandji afterwards. We'll also ensure FileVault is enabled and escrow keys rotated.

people-ops: Approving a 2-hour temporary admin for Olivia Chen to complete initial setup. Reason: initial setup required for meeting. Please record the change.

kandji-bot: Note: device record C02Z7Y8X9 not found in Kandji inventory. Enrollment will be attempted after ABM claim.

julia-it-ops: Ok created temp admin and sent creds via DM (1-hour window). Olivia — use the local admin to finish macOS setup, sign into Okta to provision your account, and we'll schedule a quick call to re-enroll the device once ABM claim completes. After ABM assignment we'll perform a supervised re-enroll which will not wipe your data but will attach the device to our MDM; if we need to reprovision we'll coordinate.

Olivia Chen: Got the creds and completed setup, Okta login worked and I can access email. Thank you so much!

rachel-it: Great. Procurement updated ABM and Julia will attempt enrollment during a maintenance window. Once Kandji sees the device we'll push the standard baseline (MDM profile, Munki/Homebrew whitelist, and gatekeeper rules).

julia-it-ops: ABM assignment completed and Kandji detected the device at 2026-04-02T15:02:10Z. Initiating re-enroll steps now — this should be transparent; we'll confirm when done.

kandji-bot: Device C02Z7Y8X9 added to Kandji inventory and enrollment profile applied. Audit: re-enroll performed by julia-it-ops.

Olivia Chen: Rebooted and saw a brief "Remote Management" banner during boot but kept my user account and apps. Looks enrolled now and company software started installing. All good from my side. Thanks team! :rocket:

people-ops: Noted in onboarding log. Reminder: temp admin was revoked and rotated.

rachel-it: Welcome aboard, Olivia. Ping #help if anything else during the first week.
